stick_birch_and_swinnerton_dyer_conjectu.question: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture
references: B. Birch, H. P. F. Swinnerton-Dyer, Notes on elliptic curves. II, J. Reine Angew. Math. 218 (1965) 79-108
Clay Mathematics Institute, Millennium Prize Problems (2000)
stick_birch_and_swinnerton_dyer_conjectu.statement: For an elliptic curve E over Q, is the rank of E(Q) equal to the order of vanishing of L(E, s) at s = 1?

stick_hodge_conjecture.question: Hodge conjecture
references: Clay Mathematics Institute, Millennium Prize Problems (2000)
stick_hodge_conjecture.statement: On a projective non-singular complex algebraic variety, is every Hodge class a rational linear combination of classes of algebraic cycles?

stick_navier_stokes_existence_and_smooth.question: Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness
references: Clay Mathematics Institute, Millennium Prize Problems (2000)
stick_navier_stokes_existence_and_smooth.statement: Do smooth, globally defined solutions exist for the three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with smooth initial data?

stick_p_versus_np.question: P versus NP
references: S. Cook, The complexity of theorem-proving procedures, STOC (1971)
Clay Mathematics Institute, Millennium Prize Problems (2000)
stick_p_versus_np.statement: Is every problem whose solutions can be verified in polynomial time also solvable in polynomial time?

ticks.claim: relativizing proof techniques cannot resolve P vs NP: there are oracles A, B with P^A = NP^A and P^B != NP^B
ticks.source: T. Baker, J. Gill, R. Solovay, Relativizations of the P =? NP question, SIAM J. Comput. 4 (1975) 431-442

ticks.claim: natural proofs cannot separate P from NP if strong pseudorandom generators exist
ticks.source: A. Razborov, S. Rudich, Natural proofs, J. Comput. System Sci. 55 (1997) 24-35

ticks.claim: algebrizing proof techniques cannot resolve P vs NP
ticks.source: S. Aaronson, A. Wigderson, Algebrization: a new barrier in complexity theory, ACM Trans. Comput. Theory 1 (2009) 2:1-2:54

stick_poincare_conjecture.question: Poincare conjecture
references: G. Perelman, The entropy formula for the Ricci flow and its geometric applications, arXiv:math/0211159 (2002)
G. Perelman, Ricci flow with surgery on three-manifolds, arXiv:math/0303109 (2003)
stick_poincare_conjecture.statement: Every simply connected closed 3-manifold is homeomorphic to the 3-sphere. SOLVED: Perelman, 2002-2003.

ticks.claim: Solved by Perelman (2002-2003) via Hamilton's Ricci flow with surgery; prize declined 2010. The stick is kept as the one Millennium problem with a proof.

stick_riemann_hypothesis.question: Riemann hypothesis
references: Riemann, Ueber die Anzahl der Primzahlen unter einer gegebenen Grösse (1859)
Clay Mathematics Institute, Millennium Prize Problems (2000)
stick_riemann_hypothesis.statement: Every non-trivial zero of the Riemann zeta function has real part 1/2.

ticks.claim: RH is equivalent to |pi(x) - li(x)| < sqrt(x) log(x) / (8 pi) for all x >= 2657
ticks.source: L. Schoenfeld, Sharper bounds for the Chebyshev functions theta(x) and psi(x). II, Math. Comp. 30 (1976) 337-360

ticks.claim: RH is equivalent to sigma(n) < e^gamma n log log n for all n > 5040 (Robin's inequality)
ticks.source: G. Robin, Grandes valeurs de la fonction somme des diviseurs et hypothese de Riemann, J. Math. Pures Appl. 63 (1984) 187-213

ticks.claim: RH is equivalent to the Mertens-type bound M(x) = O(x^(1/2 + epsilon)) for every epsilon > 0
ticks.source: E. C. Titchmarsh, The Theory of the Riemann Zeta-Function, 2nd ed. (1986), Theorem 14.25

stick_yang_mills_existence_and_mass_gap.question: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
references: Clay Mathematics Institute, Millennium Prize Problems (2000)
stick_yang_mills_existence_and_mass_gap.statement: Does a quantum Yang-Mills theory exist on R^4 for any compact simple gauge group, with a mass gap Delta > 0?
